summary: SiYuan is a privacy-first personal knowledge management system built using TypeScript and Go. It is designed to help you organise, link, and store your notes locally or on your own infrastructure.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want absolute control over their personal notes without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence may impose copyleft constraints if you plan to modify and distribute the code, and the tool competes in a crowded market of established note-taking applications.
deployNotes: As a containerised application, deployment typically requires persistent volume mounts for your data directory and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
